hooks.name: Keep RPA selectors in sync with RxTerm 98
hooks.description: When the RxTerm 98 mock changes, regenerate rpa/selectors.json and run the RPA smoke test.

action.prompt: apps/rxterm98/src/app.ts changed. Check packages/grave-robber/rpa/selectors.json against the markup it renders (input names, data-key links, #pager, #screen, .row). Update the JSON if any selector no longer matches, then run `npx vitest run packages/grave-robber apps/rxterm98` and report the result in one or two sentences. Do not touch anything else.
